title: Your own workflow runs wait for your Approve click
description: A review step in a workflow you started now waits in Human Tasks for an Approve click, even when you may decide it yourself, and with the two-person rule on a second person decides. A Send a message step sends without asking anyone; where your team's rules hold replies for approval it now takes its Error path instead of sending in your own run, so put a review step and then a Send a reply tool step where a reply needs a yes.
